senses.gloss: m. (a corrupt. of verutum, βηρύττα, S.) spit.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 146a:8">Sabb. 146ᵃ</cite> <he>למיברז … בב׳</he> to break open a barrel (of dates) by jamming a spit between the splices (Ms. M. <he>קורבוי׳</he>, Alf. ed. Cost. <cite ref="B01226"><he>בּרְזִיתָא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 27b:1">Snh. 27ᵇ</cite> top <he>קתא דב׳</he> the handle of a burtya.
